Gramlot 0.2.10 gives the browser object `Gramlot` its proxies: a first pass, to be refined as features arrive.

## What changes

- `Gramlot` keeps its lifecycle (`start`, `loadMain`, `dispose`), its data (`pageId`, `state`, `data`), the named logic (`logic`) and four proxies. Every themed member moves to its proxy with the same name:
  - `gramlot.src` (`SourceHandler`): `builder`, `source`, `renderer`, `binding`, `logicRegistry`, `startSource`, `mountMainSource`, `prepareSource`, `remoteSource`;
  - `gramlot.rpc` (`RpcHandler`): `transport`, `remoteRequests`;
  - `gramlot.dom` (`DomHandler`): `getDomNode`, `getBaseSourceNode`, `reference`;
  - `gramlot.utl` (`UtilitiesHandler`): `inout`.
- The handlers share the base class `Handler`, which holds the `gramlot` reference; the core exports all five classes. The existing classes keep their names and APIs.
- GC-225 records the rules; the guides show the new paths.

## Upgrading from 0.2.9

- Pages and Logic that use the moved members change path: `this.page.renderer.freeze(node)` → `this.page.src.renderer.freeze(node)`, `this.page.source` → `this.page.src.source`, `this.page.builder` → `this.page.src.builder`, `gramlot.inout.sendMail(...)` → `gramlot.utl.inout.sendMail(...)`. The old paths no longer exist.
- gramlot-examples is released together with this version, updated to the new paths.
